title: Input seek and rewind machine
statement: There is a deterministic Turing machine with two work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states `start`, `scan`, `left`, and `done`. It starts in `start`; in `start` it moves the input head left and enters `scan`; in `scan` it moves left and remains in `scan` when the scanned input symbol is present, and moves right and enters `left` when it is blank; in `left` it moves left and enters `done`; in `done` it stays in place and remains in `done`.
caveat: The transition helper's full action semantics are not included in the supplied definitions, so this description specifies the visible input-head movements and state changes only.
